issue.description: Parent: beadrs-41eb03d3, auto-split child 1 of 4. The script itself already landed at commit 9e7745c and must NOT be rewritten here — this child audits the committed version (plus the small uncommitted working-tree delta on top of it) against every behavior bullet of the parent bead. Audit and record verbatim script lines for each of: (1) extraction is git archive of the requested sha piped to tar -x -C into a scratch dir made with mktemp -d -p ~/scratch, and the script issues no stash, reset, checkout, or index write against /home/coding/bead-rs; (2) CARGO_TARGET_DIR is placed under the same scratch dir so no build artifact lands in the shared checkout; (3) on success the binary is copied into pinned-binaries/ with a sibling .metadata.json carrying git sha and short sha, binary sha256, cargo package version, build command and features, build timestamp, build_host scratch path, and source set to git-archive; (4) on failure the scratch dir is left in place and its path printed; (5) set -euo pipefail is present and the script only writes under ~/scratch and pinned-binaries/. Acceptance: close evidence lists each of the five bullets with the corresponding verbatim script line(s) marked conforming or non-conforming; any non-conforming bullet is recorded as a finding referenced back to beadrs-41eb03d3 instead of being patched in this child.
issue.notes:
AUDIT of scripts/build-from-archive.sh vs pinned-binary contract (parent beadrs-41eb03d3). Scope: committed copy at 9e7745c == HEAD for this file (git diff 9e7745c -- scripts/build-from-archive.sh is byte-identical to git diff HEAD -- it), plus the uncommitted working-tree delta, which changes only metadata-notes wording at lines 212-216; no logic line differs. RESULT: all five bullets CONFORMING; no findings to escalate. Audit-only child: no files changed.

B1 CONFORMING — git-archive extraction into mktemp scratch; no mutating git call. L119: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d -p "$SCRATCH_BASE" "bead-archive-$SHORT_SHA-XXXXXX") with L113: SCRATCH_BASE="$HOME/scratch" (created L114). L122: if ! git -C "$REPO" archive "$FULL_SHA" | tar -x -C "$SCRATCH"; then, with the sha resolved read-only at L96: FULL_SHA=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "$FULL_SHA^{commit}"). Exhaustive git-verb inventory: L54 rev-parse --show-toplevel, L96 rev-parse --verify --quiet, L99 show -s --format=%s, L100 show -s --format=%cI, L122 archive — all read-only. grep for stash/reset/checkout/add/clean/apply/worktree/index matches comments only (L6-L11, L206). No index, HEAD, reflog or stash write anywhere.

B2 CONFORMING — L135: if ! (cd "$SCRATCH" && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$SCRATCH/target" "${BUILD_CMD[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$BUILD_LOG"); then, consumed at L140: BIN="$SCRATCH/target/release/bead". Environment-specific check: this box exports CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build/target in login shells; the command-scoped assignment was verified to override it (env-prefix precedence tested), so no artifact can land in the shared checkout or /build/target.

B3 CONFORMING — default destination L60: OUT_DIR="$REPO/pinned-binaries"; sibling files L104/L105: DEST="$OUT_DIR/$NAME" and META="$OUT_DIR/$NAME.metadata.json" (overwrite refused L106-108); copy L150: install -m 755 "$BIN" "$DEST"; metadata block L178-221 emits every required key: git_commit_sha L187, git_commit_short L188, binary_sha256 L195, cargo_package_version L198, build_features L199, build_timestamp L192, build_host L193, build_scratch_path L194, build_command L202, and source set to git-archive via L162 (SOURCE="git-archive") flowing to L204.

B4 CONFORMING — die() L45-47 echoes "scratch dir left in place for diagnosis: $SCRATCH" to stderr; ERR trap L89 prints "FAILED — scratch dir left in place for diagnosis: ${SCRATCH:-<none created>}"; cleanup runs only on success (L227 rm -rf "$SCRATCH", L228 trap - ERR after). Bash nuance checked: on a `cmd || die` path the ERR trap is suppressed for the left-side failure, but die() itself prints the path, so the scratch path is printed on every failure after creation; the trap covers set -e failures that bypass die.

B5 CONFORMING — L29: set -euo pipefail. Complete write-site inventory: L103 mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR" (default $REPO/pinned-binaries), L114 mkdir -p "$SCRATCH_BASE" (~/scratch), L119 mktemp -d -p (~/scratch), L135 tee "$BUILD_LOG" (scratch), L150 install (DEST), L178 >"$META" (pinned-binaries), L227 rm -rf "$SCRATCH" (scratch). Everything else writes only stdout/stderr. CAVEAT (informational, for parent beadrs-41eb03d3 to rule on — not a defect of the default path): the documented --out flag (usage L16-25, parse L75-79) lets a caller redirect the pin outside pinned-binaries; all script-driven writes stay inside the two sanctioned trees.
